title: Breaking: Service Account IDs Read-Only; Private Connectivity for AWS/Azure
summary: The `serviceAccountId` fields in `AwsAccessRole` and `AzureProperties` are now read-only, a breaking change. New `serviceDirectoryService` fields enable private network connections to AWS and Azure via Cross-Cloud Interconnect.
details: The `serviceAccountId` property within the `AwsAccessRole` and `AzureProperties` schemas has been changed to `readOnly`. This means any existing code attempting to set or modify these fields will now fail. Developers must update their connection creation/update logic to no longer provide a value for `serviceAccountId`, as it is now an output-only field representing the connection's identity. This is a breaking change. Alongside this, new `serviceDirectoryService` fields have been introduced in both `AwsProperties` and `AzureProperties`. These optional fields allow you to specify a Service Directory resource name, enabling private network routing for your BigQuery connections to AWS and Azure via Cross-Cloud Interconnect. This enhances security and performance for external data sources.
